text.Battle Station:
How to Play ==
When you play the Battle Station you put an Outpost in play with a defense of 5. At any time you can scrap it to add 5 Combat Power to your attack.
 Strategy ==
For a meager 3 Trade you get an Outpost of 5 Defense which stops direct attacks on bases and your HQ. This prevents In early game small damage on your HQ. Thoughout the game a nuisance for your opponents because Outposts need to be attacked first before they can fire on bases or the HQ. Scrapping it for 5 Combat aint that bad either.
